info.title: BSS Restaurant API
info.description: The BSS Restaurant API. All routes are under `/api/v1`, JSON is camelCase, and errors always look like `{"detail": "...", "code": "..."}`.

get.description:
Whether the API is up and can reach the database. Answers 503 with `database: unreachable` when it can't, after waiting up to 5 seconds for a sleeping database.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed.

post.description:
Swaps an email and password for an access token, a refresh token and the user. Limited to 20 attempts a minute per IP and 5 in 5 minutes per account.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed.

The OAuth2 password form used by the Authorize button in `/docs`. Put the email in `username`. Clients should use **Sign in** instead.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed.

Swaps a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once; using an old one again ends the whole session. Refresh one at a time.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed.

Ends the session this refresh token belongs to. Unknown tokens are ignored.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed.

Ends every session of the signed-in user, on every device.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

get.description:
The signed-in user.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

patch.description:
Change your own name and phone number.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

post.description:
Needs the current password. Signs out every other device and returns a new token pair for this one.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

get.description:
Name, contact details, currency, VAT and service charge, and which kinds of ordering and booking are switched on.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

Restaurant details and every visible category with its foods, in one call. Sold-out foods are included with `isAvailable: false`.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

get.summary: The table behind a QR code
get.description:
The table behind a QR code, so the page can say "Table 4".

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

post.description:
The order waits as pending until a waiter confirms it. At most 3 unconfirmed orders per table. Keep the `trackingCode` to follow it.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

Needs a name and phone number, and online orders switched on. At most 3 unconfirmed orders per phone number.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

get.description:
Status, items and bill of an order. Works for any order, staff can hand out the code.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

post.description:
Only while the order is still pending and nothing was paid, see `canCancel`.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

get.description:
Times a party can book on a day, empty when the day is full or too far ahead.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

post.description:
At least an hour and at most 60 days ahead, inside opening hours, up to 20 people, 3 upcoming bookings per phone number. Keep the `trackingCode`.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

get.description:
Its status, time and table. `cancelReason` holds the restaurant's note if it was declined or cancelled.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

post.description:
Until the booking time, see `canCancel`.

**Who can call it:** No sign-in needed. Rate limited per IP.

get.description:
Name and details printed on receipts, currency, VAT and service charge, opening hours, and the ordering and booking switches.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

patch.description:
Send only what changes. New VAT and service charge rates apply to orders placed after the change.

**Who can call it:** Admins and managers.

Send the file as a form with its `folder`. Then send the returned `key` as `imageKey` (or `receiptKey`) when creating or updating the thing it belongs to. Images are checked, resized to 1600 px and stored as WebP. At most `MAX_UPLOAD_MB`, 5 MB by default.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

get.description:
Filter by status, source, type, table, waiter and restaurant dates. `?source=qr&source=online&status=pending` is the incoming list.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

post.description:
Send only what was ordered. Prices, discounts, service charge, VAT and the order number all come from the server.

**Who can call it:** Admins, managers, waiters and cashiers.

get.description:
The whole order, with its items, history and payments.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

patch.description:
Change the table, waiter, customer details or notes of an open order.

**Who can call it:** Admins, managers, waiters and cashiers.

put.description:
Replaces every line, only while the order is pending or confirmed.

**Who can call it:** Admins, managers, waiters and cashiers.

post.description:
Adds new lines, also while the kitchen is cooking. Lines already ordered keep their price.

**Who can call it:** Admins, managers, waiters and cashiers.

pending → confirmed → preparing → ready → served. Pending, confirmed and preparing orders can be cancelled with a reason. `paid` is set by itself when the bill is settled. Each move has its own roles: see the order's `nextStatuses`.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

Leave out `amount` to pay what's left. For cash, `tendered` works out the change. Mobile payments need the transaction ID as `reference`. A split bill is several payments; a served order becomes paid when nothing is left.

**Who can call it:** Admins, managers and cashiers.

At most what was paid, with a reason. A paid order stays paid. Also needed before cancelling an order that holds money.

**Who can call it:** Admins and managers.

get.description:
HTML sized for 80 mm printers: a bill while the order is open, a receipt once it's paid. `print=true` opens the print dialog when it loads.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.

Sorted by booking time, filter with `dateFrom`/`dateTo` for a day's bookings.

**Who can call it:** Any signed-in staff member.
